project_type: React + TypeScript SPA for zero-auth video conferencing using Amazon Chime SDK
build_system: Vite 5 with @vitejs/plugin-react, npm as package manager
test_framework: Vitest with jsdom environment, @testing-library/react, tests in src/**/*.test.{ts,tsx}
verification_instructions: 1. Run 'npm install' to install deps. 2. Run 'npx tsc -b' to type-check. 3. Run 'npx vitest run' to run tests. 4. Run 'npx vite build' to ensure production build succeeds.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET - full network access available. Node.js 22 available. No amplify backend available in sandbox (amplify_outputs.json is checked-in).
contribution_requirements: Uses prettier and eslint via husky pre-commit. Has strict coverage thresholds (90% branches/functions/lines/statements) but excludes certain component files from coverage.
key_patterns: Hooks pattern: custom hooks in src/hooks/ encapsulate logic (useMeeting, useRecording, useVideoMeeting). Utils in src/utils/ for pure functions. Components in src/components/. Tests mock external dependencies with vi.mock(). UI uses @aws-amplify/ui-react components (Card, View, Text, Heading, Flex, etc). Chime SDK accessed via useAudioVideo() hook. The AudioVideoFacade from Chime SDK provides realtimeSendDataMessage() and realtimeSubscribeToReceiveDataMessage() for in-meeting data messaging.
directory_structure: src/components/ - React components (VideoMeeting, MeetingControlBar, Header, etc). src/hooks/ - Custom React hooks (useMeeting, useRecording, useVideoMeeting). src/utils/ - Pure utility functions (attendee name gen, meeting pin logic). src/test/ - Test setup files. amplify/ - AWS Amplify backend definitions.
